title: QK-Wanda: Coupling Queries and Keys for Unstructured Pruning
abstract: arXiv:2610.01554v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Wanda (Sun et al., 2024) prunes large language models by scoring weights independently within each linear projection, although queries and keys interact through dot products. We introduce QK-Wanda, which scores query and key weights by their individual deletion costs under an unmasked pre-RoPE reconstruction objective. It augments Wanda scores with information from the opposite projection (keys for query weights, and queries for key weights), allowing both projections to share a pruning budget. Its closed-form scores require no gradients or weight updates; full pruning takes 1.3% longer than Wanda on A100 and 3.1% longer on H200 with the calibration used in our main experiments. We evaluate QK-only pruning across 15 models from TinyLlama, Llama 2, Llama 3, and Qwen2.5, spanning 0.5B-72B parameters. Relative to Wanda, QK-Wanda reduces QK reconstruction error by an average of 60% at 50% sparsity and 45% at 80%. Downstream gains depend on t

translated_title: QK-Wanda：耦合查询与键的非结构化剪枝
translated_abstract: Wanda（Sun et al., 2024）通过在每个线性投影内独立地对权重进行评分来剪枝大型语言模型，然而查询和键是通过点积相互作用的。我们提出了QK-Wanda，该方法通过在未掩码的预RoPE重建目标下计算单个权重的删除代价来对查询和键的权重进行评分。它通过来自对立投影的信息（键的信息用于查询权重，查询的信息用于键权重）来增强Wanda评分，使两个投影能够共享一个剪枝预算。其闭式解形式的评分不需要梯度或权重更新；在我们主要实验所用的校准方法下，完整剪枝过程在A100上仅比Wanda慢1.3%，在H200上仅慢3.1%。我们在来自TinyLlama、Llama 2、Llama 3和Qwen2.5的15个模型（参数量从0.5B到72B）上评估了QK-only剪枝。相对于Wanda，QK-Wanda在50%稀疏度下平均降低60%的QK重建误差，在80%稀疏度下降低45%。
tldr: QK-Wanda通过耦合查询和键投影的信息、利用闭式解的删除代价评分来剪枝大语言模型，在无需梯度的情况下显著降低QK重建误差（50%稀疏度下降低60%），且计算开销与Wanda几乎相同。
en_tdlr: QK-Wanda couples query and key projections by scoring weights via their closed-form deletion costs under an unmasked pre-RoPE reconstruction objective, significantly reducing QK reconstruction error (by 60% at 50% sparsity) without gradients and with nearly the same computational overhead as Wanda.
